reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed donor-average treatment contrast with hierarchical comparison, donor-grouped resampling and null calibration, and protected donor-level validation.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Donor-Randomized, Cell-Level Measured Studies
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original experimental Methods/supplements to verify allocation and sampling conditions and release-specific model protocols. Reconstructing identifiers and naming prior evidence alone is insufficient.

checks.quote: per-donor AUC
checks.reason: Treatment is constant within each donor in this design, so a within-donor treatment-class AUC has only one label class and is not defined. Use a donor-level prediction evaluated across held-out donors instead.

checks.quote: two-sample t-test / Welch test, Wilcoxon rank-sum if donor n permits
checks.reason: The primary summary/test and outcome-family implementation remain alternatives without a concrete selection rule; null calibration selects mixed versus pseudobulk but does not resolve the pseudobulk route.

checks.quote: QC thresholds
checks.reason: No objective reference-to-acceptance calibration rule sets the assay QC thresholds and failure response.

checks.quote: precision-weighting donor summaries by cell count only if calibration
checks.reason: Type-I calibration alone does not ensure cell-count weighting preserves the donor-average estimand under informative cell yield. The target and weighting relationship are not fixed.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Donor-Randomized, Cell-Level Measured Studies
checks.reason: No operational missing-donor/attrition policy or explicit distinction between biological cell loss and technical QC failure. Low-yield sensitivity does not replace this rule.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Donor-Randomized, Cell-Level Measured Studies
checks.reason: Multiple endpoint/co-primary tests are proposed without a selected multiplicity procedure/family or matching single primary inferential decision.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Donor-Randomized, Cell-Level Measured Studies
checks.reason: Troubleshooting and fallback methods are specified but a changed procedure is not explicitly refrozen and assigned fresh independent confirmation.

checks.quote: Hierarchical-model estimate agrees in sign and the cluster-bootstrap CI excludes the null
checks.reason: Acceptance still requires the mixed-model result even when the prespecified fallback rejects that model for calibration/convergence failure. The fallback and final acceptance rules conflict.

checks.quote: Held-out validation (for any predictive/classifier claim or multivariate signature)
checks.reason: Held-out validation is limited to predictive claims; no operational independent donor validation of the proposed primary treatment contrast is provided.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Donor-Randomized, Cell-Level Measured Studies
checks.reason: No immutable raw input hashes, pinned executable environment and exact analysis commands link identifiers to outputs.

checks.quote: Cells from a donor never appear in both training and test folds.
checks.reason: Donor grouping is correct, but every transformation, feature selection and threshold fit is not explicitly restricted to each training fold.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Donor-Randomized, Cell-Level Measured Studies
checks.reason: No clean-environment numerical reproduction of donor-effect and null-calibration outputs with tolerances and runtime/resource/failure logs.

checks.quote: # Proposed Analysis and Validation Protocol for Donor-Randomized, Cell-Level Measured Studies
checks.reason: Correct donor allocation, nonidentifiability of saturated donor fixed effects, enumeration resolution, null-imposed simulations and grouped bootstrap. Finite weighted/unweighted alternatives are calibrated. Per-donor AUC is invalid for a donor-constant label, target weighting is unresolved and the fallback/acceptance rules conflict.
